label: Commutativity of addition
description: a + b = b + a for any a, b. Its own conceptual milestone: a child fluent with 1+2 may not yet have generalised that 2+1 gives the same result, so this is not assumed automatically from single-instance mastery.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
